author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh from the garden and full of bold flavor — homemade adjika is a wonderful way to preserve the season’s harvest 🌶️🍅 In this video, we prepare traditional adjika using ripe tomatoes, fresh peppers, garlic, herbs, and other garden ingredients.

Slowly cooked until rich and aromatic, the vegetables blend into a flavorful sauce with the perfect balance of spice, freshness, and natural sweetness. It’s delicious alongside meat, bread, potatoes, or your favorite homemade dishes.

This is traditional village preserving at its best — fresh garden vegetables, simple ingredients, and a time-tested homemade method. A flavorful way to capture the taste of summer and enjoy it throughout the colder months. 🌿🔥
title: Homemade Adjika Made with Fresh Garden Vegetables 🌶️🍅
